sleep-tracker.title: Sleep check-in
sleep-tracker.description: Notice timing, rest, and what gets in the way of sleep.
fields: I usually get into bed around
I usually fall asleep around
I usually wake up around
Estimated hours of sleep
I wake during the night
Do I feel rested when I wake? Yes / Sometimes / No
What tends to interfere with my sleep?
One experiment I will try this week
What did I notice?
sleep-tracker.note: Discuss persistent sleep problems or major changes in your need for sleep with your healthcare professional.

caffeine-tracker.title: Caffeine check-in
caffeine-tracker.description: Record sources, amounts, timing, and patterns you want to discuss.
fields: Coffee, tea, soda, energy drinks, supplements, or other sources
Approximately how much caffeine am I getting each day? (mg)
What time is my last caffeine of the day?
Why am I usually reaching for it?
What have I noticed about sleep, anxiety, heart rate, or energy?
One caffeine experiment
What happened?
caffeine-tracker.note: Do not change prescribed medication based solely on this worksheet. Discuss medication or symptom concerns with your provider.

movement-tracker.title: Movement experiment
movement-tracker.description: Try realistic movement and notice how you feel before and after.
fields: Movement I enjoy or would like to try
This week I will try
For approximately how many minutes?
Before: mood / energy / stress / focus (0–10)
After: mood / energy / stress / focus (0–10)
What did I notice?
movement-tracker.note: Choose activity appropriate for your health and circumstances. Seek medical attention for concerning symptoms with activity.

nutrition-tracker.title: Food and hydration check-in
nutrition-tracker.description: Notice regular meals, appetite, hydration, and one small experiment.
fields: What do my meal and hydration patterns look like?
What makes eating regularly difficult?
What have I noticed about appetite or medication timing?
One experiment I could try
What changed in energy, mood, focus, or appetite?
Questions for my provider
nutrition-tracker.note: Individual needs vary. This tool is not a prescribed diet or a substitute for individualized medical or nutritional advice.

medication-tracker.title: Medication visit check-in
medication-tracker.description: Prepare notes about benefits, side effects, and questions for your appointment.
fields: What has improved?
What has not improved?
Any side effects?
How often have I missed a dose?
How am I sleeping? Has my appetite changed?
Have caffeine, nicotine, alcohol, cannabis, or other substance patterns changed?
What question do I want to remember to ask?
medication-tracker.note: Do not start, stop, split, or change a prescribed medication without following your prescribing professional’s instructions.

connection-tracker.title: Connection experiment
connection-tracker.description: Choose one small step toward meaningful connection.
fields: How connected do I feel right now?
Who can I contact when I am struggling?
A relationship or community I would like to strengthen
One small action this week
Before: connection and mood (0–10)
After: connection and mood (0–10)
What did I notice?
connection-tracker.note: Seek individualized support when a relationship involves abuse, threats, coercion, or immediate danger.

regulation-tracker.title: My regulation menu
regulation-tracker.description: Explore which tools help in different moments.
fields: What am I noticing in my body, thoughts, and emotions?
Do I need to calm my system or activate it?
When anxious or overstimulated, I could try
When shut down or stuck, I could try
Someone I can contact
What I tried; distress before and after (0–10)
What did I learn?
regulation-tracker.note: This is an educational support tool, not a diagnosis, treatment, or individualized crisis plan.

substance-tracker.title: Substance-use reflection
substance-tracker.description: Collect information for a nonjudgmental conversation with your provider.
fields: What did I use, how much, and what time?
What was happening immediately beforehand?
How did I feel afterward?
How did I sleep and feel the next day?
What did I learn?
What would I like to discuss at my next visit?
substance-tracker.note: Abruptly stopping some substances can cause dangerous withdrawal. Talk with a healthcare professional when physical dependence may be present.
